title: Multiline list of array shapes preserves its element fields

ground_truth.statement: links returns a list of records with string href and lang. A multiline generic argument does not change the shape, and indexing the returned lang produces the string en.

provenance.note: Re-derived the multiline generic list shape. Inlined the source's Psalm-specific local alias to compare the common type grammar; used a nonempty implementation so field inference is exercised.

notes: This portable fixture measures multiline type parsing and field inference, not alias-name scoping. A successful runtime is not by itself proof that an analyzer parsed the annotation; the string consumer constrains its inferred output.
